response.sql: SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.ALP) AS avg_ALP, AVG(l.HCT) AS avg_HCT FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = p.ID WHERE p.ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE `U-PRO` = '-' AND RA = '-') GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX ORDER BY (AVG(l.HCT) IS NULL), AVG(l.HCT) DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The qualifying lab record must have both U-PRO = '-' and RA = '-' on the same row; averages are then computed over all of the patient's lab records, not just the qualifying ones.
Ties in average HCT are broken arbitrarily since no tie-breaker was requested.
